Messages.Author: Jim Parker
Messages.Body:
Hi. I only recently received my lot of Sabbat War cards; one box of
boosters and four starters. All was going well until I reached the !Brujah
starter. After rifleing through the first few vamps, I noticed there were
three copies of Victor in a row, and then another one later. The first
fifteen cards were all vampires. I thought this to be a bit strange and
apon counting the total number of cards, was perturbed to find I had only
79 cards. Somewhere in the middle of the starter were another 5 Amelia's
and two more Victor's. Among the cards missing were Taste of Vitae
(grrr...), Direct intervention (GRRR), and Immortal Grapple (ARRGGHH!!!).

I was aware of a few qualms regarding the first printing of boosters, but
has anyone encountered the same sort of problem with starters?
